items.exampleEn: This is a commercial building, not a home.
items.exampleZh: 這是一棟商業大樓，不是住家。

items.exampleEn: My parents and I made an agreement about screen time.
items.exampleZh: 我和爸媽針對使用螢幕的時間達成了協議。

items.exampleEn: The teacher praised the students' good conduct.
items.exampleZh: 老師稱讚學生們良好的行為。

items.exampleEn: Which department do you work in?
Leadership is an important skill for managers.
items.exampleZh: 領導能力是經理的重要技能。

items.exampleEn: This document is written in three languages.
items.exampleZh: 這份文件是用三種語言寫成的。

items.exampleEn: I like the design of this magazine, but not its content.
items.exampleZh: 我喜歡這本雜誌的設計，但不喜歡它的內容。

items.exampleEn: The film's producer was very happy with the result.
items.exampleZh: 這部電影的製作人對結果很滿意。

items.sentenceEn: This agreement is three pages long.

items.audioEn: Please sign the document and return it to the sales department by Monday.
items.audioZh: 請在文件上簽名，並在星期一前交回業務部。
options: The office next to the lift.

items.sentenceEn: Please put the documents in the blue folder.
items.sentenceZh: 請把文件放進藍色資料夾。

items.sentenceEn: Commercial flights stopped because of the storm.
items.sentenceZh: 因為暴風雨，商業航班停飛了。

items.stemEn: The ____ of this website is very useful for students.
items.stemZh: 這個網站的內容對學生很有用。

items.stemEn: The two companies reached a final ____ after many meetings.
items.stemZh: 兩家公司在多次開會後達成了最終協議。

items.passageEn: Our department signed an agreement with a TV producer to make a short commercial video about our company. The producer sent us a long document that explained the content of the video. The video will also show our new slogan. Under the leadership of our manager, the team finished the work in two weeks. The agreement also had rules about staff conduct during filming: for example, no phones were allowed.
items.passageZh: 我們部門和一位電視製作人簽了協議，要拍一支介紹公司的商業短片。製作人寄給我們一份很長的文件，說明影片的內容。影片也會呈現我們的新標語。在經理的領導下，團隊兩週就完成了工作。協議裡也有關於員工在拍攝期間行為的規定：例如，不准使用手機。

questions.questionZh: 拍攝期間員工不能做什麼？

items.promptZh: 她的爸爸是一位電視製作人。
referenceEn: Her father is a TV producer.
Her dad is a producer on TV.
rubricZh: producer 表示「製作人」，可數名詞，例如 a TV producer 等說法
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式等）

items.promptZh: 在她的領導下，球隊贏得了冠軍。
referenceEn: Under her leadership, the team won the championship.
Under her leadership, the team became champions.
rubricZh: 用 leadership 表示「領導」（例如 under her leadership）
「贏得冠軍」可寫，例如 won the championship、became champions 等
